out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at a few handwashing sinks.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS TO ALL SINKS MISSING TOWELS AT TIME OF INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD ALWAYS BE PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH SOAP AND TOWELS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED PARTIALLY COOKED POTATOES AT 52F IN THE 4-DOOR STACKED COOLER; OBSERVED SHREDDED CHEESE AT 53F AND SLICED CHEESE AT 61F IN THE TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP (NEAR BREAKFAST SERVICE AREA).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF POTATOES AND MOVED CHEESES TO ANOTHER COOLER. PIC UNDERSTANDS THE FOUR-DOOR STACKED COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F. PLEASE KEEP THE PREP-TOP PORTION OF THE PREP-TOP COOLER CLOSED WHEN NOT IN USE TO HELP MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: FOUR-DOOR STACKED COOLER OBSERVED AT 56 (DIGITAL THERMOMETER READ AT 37F).
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED PARTIALLY COOKED POTATOES IN THE COOLER AND MOVED ALL OTHER FOODS. PIC CONTACTED A BUILDING ENGINEER DURING THE INSPECTION TO LOOK AT THE COOLER. PLEASE ENSURE IT IS NOT USED UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE EXTERIOR AND INTERIOR OF SOME COLD HOLDING UNITS IN NEED OF CLEANING AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PIC UNDERSTANDS COOLERS SHOULD BE CLEANED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED Y SPLITTER INSTALLED AT THE MOP SINK AT STARBUCKS.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC SHOWED BUILDING ENGINEER THE MOP SINK AT TIME OF INSPECTION AND WILL ENSURE THE SPLITTER IS REMOVED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. ESTABLISHMENT IS AWARE OF APPROVED SPLITTER.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink IN BACK KITCHEN OF STARBUCKS AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS DURING INSPECTION AND WILL ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK IN BACK KITCHEN AT STARBUCKS AREA MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 77F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC CONTACTED MAINTENANCE TEAM DURING INSPECTION AND WILL ENSURE PROOF OF CORRECTION IS PROVIDED TO THE EHS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink (soup station, dish washing area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. Soap was provided.
